title: RDS / SCA: two FM stations taking turns on 98.5 MHz
description: tools/scene_two.json at 2.4 MHz, 12 s looped, the stations 400 kHz off the tuner centre: 'Kraken FM' (RDS, PI 9201, New Zealand ECC: PS, RadioText + RT+ title / artist, PTY Pop music + PTYN, clock time UTC+13, AF list, EON, Long PS, a TA, a 67 kHz SCA playing a C-E-G tone sequence) at 60 deg for 0.3-5.8 s, then 'KRKN' (RBDS, the PI = call sign KRKN, US ECC: PS, RadioText, PTY Talk, a 92 kHz FSK data SCA at 4800 bit/s, an RDS2 data stream on 66.5 kHz) at 200 deg for 6.2-11.7 s. Expect a talker per PI at those bearings (PI 9201 / PI 3DF5), both stations in the decoder table, the subcarriers in the facts; Listen plays the SCA tones while Kraken FM is on air.
